title: Reverberation time
caption: Sabine's formula RT₆₀ = 0.161V/A gives 1.61 s for 2000 m³ and 200 m² of absorption: the time for the sound to fall by 60 dB after the source stops. For 1.0 s the hall needs 322 m² of absorption.
alt: Sound level relative to the start, falling in a straight line from 0 to minus 60 decibels at 1.61 seconds.
description: After the source stops, the level falls at a steady rate in decibels per second.
axisLabels: time after the source stops / s
